name: profai-graph-review
description: Two-engine defect hunt: fan-out reviewers over the diff, path sweep over reachable states. Agents find, the owner decides.

interface.shortDescription: Two-engine defect hunt for agentic systems
interface.longDescription: Engine 1 fans out independent reviewers with disjoint charters across the diff. Engine 2 ignores the diff and enumerates reachable states to find dead ends, retry-blind errors, and forced tool calls with no escape hatch. Findings are classified as class or instance, survive an adversarial kill attempt, and are handed to the owner as a decision list. The skill never fixes anything on its own.
defaultPrompt: Run a graph review on the slice I just finished.
Sweep reachable states for dead ends before deploy.
Hunt defects in this diff and hand me a decision list.
